name: Unique Eco Viva
shortDescription: Ten energy-efficient 3- and 4-bedroom pool villas of 330-450 sqm in Chalong, with solar panels, EV chargers and smart-home systems.
description:
Unique Eco Viva is a small estate of 10 two-storey pool villas in Chalong, at the foot of a forested hill, by the developer of Unique Villa Naiharn. The concept is energy efficiency: each villa has a 5 kW solar system, inverter air-conditioning, a heat-pump water heater, insulated walls and roof, UV-reflective glazing, an underground rainwater tank, a smart-home system and an EV charger.
There are three- and four-bedroom designs of about 330 to 450 sqm on plots of about 280 to 475 sqm, each with a private pool and a covered sala. The estate has 24-hour security, two parking spaces per villa, and pets are allowed.
Kata Beach is about 3.4 km away, with Rawai and Nai Harn a short drive further; international kindergartens and schools are within a few kilometres. Villas are built to order in about 14 months; foreign buyers hold the land on a registered lease.
